options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The goal to accomplish in order to complete the seed.
- Beat Veran: beat the usual final boss
- Beat Ganon: teleport to the Room of Rites after beating Onox or Veran, then beat Ganon (same as linked game)
- Collect Maku Seed - Don't Feel like fighting Veran or Ganon to goal? Then don't! (similar to a triforce hunt in ALTTPR)

options.name: Logic Difficulty
options.doc:
The difficulty of the logic used to generate the seed.
- Casual: expects you to know what you would know when playing the game for the first time
- Medium: expects you to know well the alternatives on how to do basic things, but won't expect any trick
- Hard: expects you to know difficult tricks such as bomb jumps
- Hell: expects you to use tricks and glitches that span over more than a few inputs

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Open Advance Shop
options.doc:
In the vanilla game, there is a house (northwest of Horon Village in Seasons, and south of the maku tree entrance in Lynna Village for Ages) hosting the secret "Advance Shop" that can only
be accessed if the game is being played on a Game Boy Advance console.
If enabled, this option makes this shop always open, adding 3 shop locations to the game (and some rupees to the
item pool to compensate for the extra purchases that might be required)

options.name: Deterministic Gasha Locations
options.doc:
When set to a non-zero value, planting a Gasha tree on a unique soil gives a deterministic item which is taken
into account by logic. Once an item has been obtained this way, the soil disappears forever to avoid any chance
of softlocking by wasting several Gasha Seeds on the same soil.
The value of this option is the number of items that can be obtained that way, the maximum value expecting you
to plant a tree on each one of the 16 Gasha spots in the game.

options.name: Secret Locations
options.doc: When enabled, add the linked game secrets to the list of locations

options.name: Linked Hero's Cave
options.doc:
Adds linked hero's cave to a list of locations for you to complete. This option also allows you to mark which location the linked hero's cave will be in.
- Maku Tree Entrance Right Side: A cave will be placed to the right side of the maku tree entrance
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute la grotte du héros à une liste d'emplacements à compléter. Cette option vous permet également de marquer l'emplacement de la grotte du héros lié.
- Maku Tree Entrée à droite: Une grotte sera placée à droite de l'entrée maku tree

options.name: Miniboss Locations
options.doc: When enabled, all minibosses will have a check that you will need to get each time they are defeated.

options.name: Vasu Additionnal Rings enabled
options.doc: When enabled, vasu will congradulate you based off of the number of rupees (for Rupee Ring check), and number of enemies defeated (for Slayer's Ring check).

options.name: Required Essences
options.doc:
The amount of essences that need to be obtained in order to get the seed from the Maku Tree and be able
to fight the final boss (depends on Goal Settings)

options.name: Shuffle Essences
options.doc:
If enabled, essences will be shuffled anywhere in the multiworld instead of being guaranteed to be found
at the end their respective dungeons.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, les essences seront mélangées n'importe où dans le multimonde au lieu d'être garanties d'être trouvées à la fin de leurs donjons respectifs.

options.name: Animal Companion
options.doc:
Determines which animal companion you can summon using the Flute, as well as the layout of the Natzu region.
- Ricky: the kangaroo with boxing skills
- Dimitri: the swimming dinosaur who can eat anything
- Moosh: the flying blue bear (in seasons, he has a passion for Spring Bananas)
options.doc_fr:
Détermine quel compagnon animal vous pouvez appeler en utilisant la flûte, ainsi que la disposition de la région de Natzu.
- Ricky: le kangourou avec des compétences de boxe
- Dimitri: le dinosaure qui peut manger n'importe quoi
- Moosh: l'ours bleu volant (en saisons, il a une passion pour les bananes de printemps)

options.name: Default Seed Type
options.doc:
Determines which of the 5 seed types will be the "default seed type", which is given:
- when obtaining Seed Satchel
- when obtaining Slingshot or Seed Shooter
- by Horon (or Lynna) Seed Tree
options.doc_fr:
Détermine lequel des cinq types de semences sera le "type de semences par défaut", qui est donné:
- lors de l'obtention de Seed Satchel
- lors de l'obtention de Slingshot ou Seed Shooter
- par Horon (ou Lynna) arbre de semences

options.name: Duplicate Seed Trees
options.doc:
The game contains 8 seed trees, but only 5 types of seeds. This means that some types of seeds can appear on
multiple trees. This setting lets you choose seed trees that will be guaranteed to not hold a unique type of
seed. You can choose up to 3.
Regardless of what you choose, each seed type will appear on at most 2 trees.
Valid choices are:
- Lynna City
- Ambi's Palace
- Deku Forest
- Symmetry City
- Crescent Island
- Rolling Ridge West
- Rolling Ridge East
- Zora Village

options.name: Warp to Start Location
options.doc:
This option changes the spot you warp in when you press select or start, A, and B buttons to warp back to the forest of time.
Please note that depending on the option you select, logic will be affected.

options.name: Lynna Gardener
options.doc:
When enabled, a friendly gardener will have trimmed the bushes outside of Lynna City and cleared the path
so you don't have to! This will expand the sphere 0 checks to include everything past the bushes that you
normally would need nothing for.
It is recommended to have this enabled for multiworlds.

options.name: Entrances Randomizer (ER)
options.doc:
When enabled, entrances in the overworld will lead to a random cave/house/dungeon/etc. picked at generation time.
- disabled : no entrances are randomized
- dungeon_only : Only dungeon are randomized with each other.
- all_entrances : All overworld and dungeon entrances are randomized

/!\ DON'T ENABLE THIS IF YOU NEVER RANDOMIZED OR PLAYED THIS GAME BEFORE
/!\ The all_entrances option require extensive knowledge of the game to really be enjoyable. 

/!\ The dungeon_only is here for you to have a taste of it without being overwhelming.
/!\ full ER tend to be quite longer than regular randomized run, as it's quite easy to forget what is where, and
/!\ where is what. It is not recommended to enable it when playing with other players without asking for there consent.
/!\ Also please, don't activate it in big async (or ever smaller async for that matter) without the organizer's autorization.

/!\ You're more likely to get stuck, as some spot can lead to softlocks. You still have the warp to start to unlock you
/!\ Please read the FAQ of the game before asking question about being stuck in the game channel (this also apply for normal games...)
/!\ It is recommended to play this with the Universal Tracker and with some kind of note to keep track of the important
/!\ entrances, because sadly nobody will be mad enough to make a tracker that helps you in this context, and even more so
/!\ when rolling ridge is a thing in this game. We hope you know what you're doing. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

options.name: ER Past/Present Pairing
options.doc:
When ER is set to all entrances and this is enabled, past entrance will be grouped together and randomized 
with each other instead of being randomized with the present ones, and vice-versa.
Work with Surface/Underwater Pairing

options.name: ER Surface/Underwater Pairing
options.doc:
When ER is set to all entrances and this is enabled, underwater entrance will be grouped together and randomized 
with each other instead of being randomized with the surfaces ones, and vice-versa.
Work with Past/Present Pairing

options.name: ER Dungeon/Standard Door Pairing
options.doc:
When ER is set to all entrances and this is enabled, dungeon entrances will be grouped together and randomized with each other
instead of being randomized with the others without taking in consideration Past/Present & Surface/Underwater pairing 
(i.e. even if Past/Present & Surface/Underwater pairing are enabled, D7 can always pair itself with D8)
If not enabled, dungeon follow the Past/Present & Surface/Underwater pairing like any other entrances

options.name: ER Inside Lock
options.doc:
Determine how locked doors / caves / bushes behave when you try to exit them when they are not open with entrance randomization.
- fully_blocked : you can't exit to a blocked exit if it wasn't open before.
- conditionnal_block : you can't exit to a blocked exit if you don't have the item required to open that exit. If you do the exit automatically open
- fully_open : the exit always automatically open if reached from the inside
NOTE : 
* Does nothing if ER is fully disabled
* This doesn't include underwater entrances & symmetry city present. (They will always drown you if you don't have the mermaid suit or saved symettry city)
* Bombable walls require you to have received bombs or bombchu without the need to use them and same goes for bushes and ember seeds
* Library present will automatically open only with fully_open (this will open both past & present) and require you to find and open the past exit otherwise 
* Exit to the cave behind moblin fort without destroying it will still block you in fully_open as it's linked to a location check
* Exitting Jabu Jabu still require the explicit permission from the king. So even if you cleaned the waters and saved him, you need to find the king to open jabu jabu entrance
options.doc_fr:
Déterminez comment se comportent les portes / grottes / buissons verrouillés lorsque vous essayez de les sortir quand ils ne sont pas ouverts avec randomisation d'entrée.
- Fullly blocked : vous ne pouvez pas sortir vers une sortie bloquée si elle n'était pas ouverte avant.
- conditionnal block : vous ne pouvez pas sortir vers une sortie bloquée si vous n'avez pas l'élément nécessaire pour ouvrir cette sortie. Si vous faites la sortie automatiquement ouvrir
- fully open : la sortie s'ouvre toujours automatiquement si elle est atteinte depuis l'intérieur NOTE :
* Ne fait rien si les urgences sont complètement désactivées
* Cela n'inclut pas les entrées sous-marines et la ville de symétrie présente. (Ils vous noient toujours si vous n'avez pas le costume de sirène ou la ville de symmétrie sauvée)
* Les murs à bombes exigent que vous ayez reçu des bombes ou des bombchu sans avoir besoin de les utiliser et les mêmes choses pour les buissons et les graines de braise
* La bibliothèque présente s'ouvrira automatiquement seulement avec Full open (cela ouvrira le passé et le présent) et vous demandera de trouver et d'ouvrir la sortie passée autrement
* Sortie vers la grotte derrière le fort de Moblin sans la détruire vous bloquera toujours en pleine ouverte car elle est liée à un contrôle d'emplacement
* La sortie de Jabu Jabu nécessite toujours la permission explicite du roi. Donc, même si vous avez nettoyé les eaux et l'avez sauvé, vous devez trouver le roi pour ouvrir l'entrée de Jabu Jabu

options.name: ER Excluded Entrance
options.doc:
Determine entrances that won't be shuffled when ER is enabled
NOTE : 
* Also work with dungeon shuffle
* Does nothing if ER is fully disabled
* All entrances' names can be found here : https://github.com/josephanimate2021/ArchipelagoOoA/blob/ooa/worlds/tloz_ooa/data/Entrances.py
*
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer les entrées qui ne seront pas remorquées lorsque ER est activé NOTE :
* Travaillez aussi avec le shuffle de donjon
* Ne fait rien si les urgences sont complètement désactivées
* Tous les noms d'entrée peuvent être trouvés ici : https://github.com/josephanimate2021/ArchipelagoOoA/blob/ooa/worlds/tloz_ooa/data/Entrances.py
*

options.name: Master Keys
options.doc:
- Disabled: All dungeon keys must be obtained individually, just like in vanilla
- All Small Keys: Small Keys are replaced by a single Master Key for each dungeon which is capable of opening
  every small keydoor for that dungeon
- All Dungeon Keys: the Master Key for each dungeon is also capable of opening the boss keydoor,
  removing Boss Keys from the item pool
Master Keys placement is determined following the "Keysanity (Small Keys)" option.
options.doc_fr:
- Disabled: Toutes les clés du donjon doivent être obtenues individuellement, comme dans la vanille
- All Small Keys: Les petites clés sont remplacées par une seule clé principale pour chaque donjon qui est capable d'ouvrir chaque petite porte pour ce donjon
- All Dungeon Keys: la clé principale pour chaque donjon est également capable d'ouvrir le porte-clés patron, enlevant les clés Boss de la piscine d'objets
Le placement des clés maîtresses est déterminé à la suite de l'option « clés (petites clés) ».

options.name: Keysanity (Small Keys)
options.doc: If enabled, dungeon Small Keys can be found anywhere instead of being confined in their dungeon of origin.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, le donjon des petites clés peut être trouvé n'importe où au lieu d'être confiné dans leur donjon d'origine.

options.name: Keysanity (Boss Keys)
options.doc: If enabled, dungeon Boss Keys can be found anywhere instead of being confined in their dungeon of origin.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, les clés du donjon Boss peuvent être trouvées n'importe où au lieu d'être confinées dans leur donjon d'origine.

options.name: Maps & Compasses Outside Dungeon
options.doc: If enabled, Dungeon Maps and Compasses can be found anywhere instead of being confined in their dungeon of origin.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, les cartes Dungeon et les compasses peuvent être trouvés n'importe où au lieu d'être confinés dans leur donjon d'origine.

options.name: Required Slates
options.doc: The amount of slate that need to be obtained in order to get to the boss of the eighth dungeons.

options.name: Slates Outside Dungeon 8
options.doc: If enabled, Slates can be found anywhere instead of being confined in Dungeon 8.
options.doc_fr: Si activé, on peut trouver des Slates n'importe où au lieu d'être confiné dans Dungeon 8.

options.name: Gasha Nut Requirement
options.doc:
This option lets you configure how many kills are required to make a gasha tree grow.
Using a gasha ring halves this number.

options.name: Vasu Rupee Ring Requirement
options.doc:
if Vasu Additionnal Rings enabled, this set the number of rupees you need to collect in order for vasu to give you a check. (from 1 to 9999)
/!\ Above 1000, the logic assume that you will need to farm in some capacity as there will certainly not be enough rupees in the pool, so be aware of it before you go beyond that number.

options.name: Vasu Slayer Ring Requirement
options.doc: if Vasu Additionnal Rings enabled, this set the amount of enemies that you need to defeat in order for vasu to give you a check. (from 1 to 1000)

options.name: Required Rings
options.doc:
Forces a specified set of rings to appear somewhere in the seed.
Adding too many rings to this list can cause generation failures.
List of ring names can be found here: https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Magic_Ring
options.doc_fr:
Force un ensemble spécifié d'anneaux à apparaître quelque part dans la semence.
Ajouter trop d'anneaux à cette liste peut causer des échecs de génération.
Liste des noms de bagues disponibles ici: https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Magic_Ring

options.name: Excluded Rings
options.doc:
Forces a specified set of rings to not appear in the seed.
List of ring names can be found here: https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Magic_Ring
options.doc_fr:
Force un ensemble spécifié d'anneaux à ne pas apparaître dans la semence.
Liste des noms de bagues disponibles ici: https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Magic_Ring

options.name: Prices Factor (%)
options.doc:
A factor (expressed as percentage) that will be applied to all prices inside all shops in the game.
- Setting it at 10% will make all items almost free
- Setting it at 500% will make all items horrendously expensive, use at your own risk!
options.doc_fr:
Un facteur (exprimé en pourcentage) qui sera appliqué à tous les prix dans tous les magasins dans le jeu.
- Régler à 10% rendra tous les articles presque gratuits
- Régler à 500% fera tous les articles horriblement cher, utiliser à vos risques et périls!

options.name: Combat Difficulty
options.doc:
Modifies the damage taken during combat to make this aspect of the game easier or harder depending on the
type of experience you want to have

options.name: Potion always available
options.doc:
When enabled, the potion will always be available in the selected shop and will refill.
WARNING : THIS POTION DOESN'T CURE KING ZORA, you still need to find a specific (blue) potion to cure him
- disabled : The potion is not available by default, and if it's still in a shop, you can only buy it once
- lynna_shop : A check will be removed in Lynna City's shop and potions will always be sold here
- syrup_hut : A check will be removed in Syrup Hut and potions will always be sold here

options.name: Bird Hint
options.doc:
Disabled: The Owls and Know-it-all birds say their vanilla text when talked to
Know-it-all: Enable region hints from the birds in the house next to the advance shop
Owl: Enable owls to give hints about items from your world
options.doc_fr: Disabled: Les Owls et les oiseaux savent-il-tous disent leur texte de vanille quand parlé à Know-it-all: Activer les conseils de la région des oiseaux dans la maison à côté de l'avant-boutique Owl: Permettre aux hiboux de donner des conseils sur les articles de votre monde
